prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a six-view PRODUCT CONCEPT atlas, one landscape 4:3 image in an EXACT 3-column 2-row equal cell layout. Input1 authoritative selected MOVERNO shoe. Input2 exact gate emblem only. Input3 exact wordmark only. Do NOT redesign shoe. Preserve: Medium-high slim classic high-top. Smoky gray translucent/ripstop gridded-looking upper over LARGE low-contrast bone-gray elongated gate chambers repeating vertically with tiny faded red joins. Black smooth eyestay, black toe rim, black heel triangular reinforcement, ivory flat laces through round silver eyelets, thin black rear loop. Flat aged ivory cupsole with front diamond texture and black thin bottom. Preserve specific quiet translucent-looking monogram pattern; no black/gold ornate overlay, no zipper. Top row left-to-right: OUTER lateral profile, INNER medial profile, FRONT straight-on. Bottom row: REAR straight-on, TOP-DOWN with toe toward bottom, OUTSOLE bottom with toe toward top. Six full shoes, one per cell, entirely contained, adequate breathing space, gray neutral seamless background consistent across cells, soft catalog light. Every view same shoe geometry and sole volume. Preserve existing exterior markings and pattern. Add restrained small MOVERNO lettering to tongue uppermost patch or loop and a small gate to rear heel center only where anatomically appropriate. Gate: two independent opposing upright curved blades, straight outer vertical edges, visible OPEN vertical center slit, not X or butterfly. New outsole is conceptual continuation of original visible rim and segments in black with discreet tonal lettering, with small molded MOVERNO in a recessed midfoot island. Keep text legible spelled M-O-V-E-R-N-O, no extra words, no label headings, no diagram or arrows, no new side logos or extra hardware, no colored accents beyond source. Do not paint lettering over existing cage or wrap straps. High quality photorealistic concept. NOT a techpack/measurement drawing.
QC PRIORITY: Do not add any logo, plaque, tab or badge to the TOE. Every toe must exactly match the unbranded toe of the original. MOVERNO is spelled with exactly 7 letters M O V E R N O. Prefer a small horizontal tongue label rather than vertical letters on a pull loop. Use the same tongue-label construction in FRONT and TOP views. Side motifs must not migrate to the toe. Six panels must have equal columns and equal rows, enough margin to show the entire shoes.
